agreements: Gearbox v1 VERIFIED_PASS and Step009 Heartbeat VERIFIED_FOUNDATION remain preserved; this review mutates neither formal state nor candidate code and does not claim C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime remain zero Experience.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only at the v2.1 semantic boundary and cannot become verified Experience by repetition.
verified_progress_density is reason-only in current v2.1 and must remain observational until independently derived and anti-self-reinforcement tested.
Strict bool intake exists for inherited v2 authority-sensitive booleans and v2.1 secretary/authority flags; prior truthiness defects are not current findings.
Speed improvement remains NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED; commit count, wake count, heartbeat count, window age and awake time are invalid substitutes.

disagreements.finding: The v2 contract names the speed-quality metric rework_or_rollback_ratio while the v2.1 contract names rework_ratio. Without a single canonical numerator/denominator schema, baseline and candidate can count rollback differently and manufacture an apparent speedup without any real improvement.
disagreements.required_change: Freeze a versioned SpeedMetricManifest before paired evaluation. It must define whether rollback is included in rework, exact numerator and denominator event classes, censoring/exposure rules, and the same manifest hash for both baseline and candidate. Metric-definition changes require a new experiment epoch and cannot be compared as one paired result.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events accepts arbitrary Iterable input with no precommitted record/time/memory budget or resumable continuation cursor; huge or nonterminating batches can stall ingestion and bias latency/availability.
disagreements.required_change: Add bounded resumable ingestion with deterministic BATCH_LIMIT_REACHED and replay-safe continuation; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: v2.1 parses anti-thrash/progress telemetry before inherited v2 can produce trusted R/N, so malformed nonessential telemetry can suppress terminal safety evaluation.
disagreements.required_change: Terminal authority must precede nonessential telemetry, or telemetry must be independently validated and unable to suppress authenticated rollback/standby.

disagreements.finding: Only secretary_level is freshness-gated; numeric pressure fields are not bound per-field to source/freshness, so stale secretary-derived telemetry can still force checkpoint/downshift.
disagreements.required_change: Bind every routing telemetry component to typed source/freshness/scope/policy provenance and exclude stale/conflicting secretary-derived components individually.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh is caller-declared; literal true can label stale telemetry fresh because source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, scope, policy and runtime/install identity are unbound.
disagreements.required_change: Consume a replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope with trusted source, freshness, scope and policy metadata.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict=true only replaces secretary_level with UNKNOWN; it does not load, validate or enforce the actual fresh authority decision.
disagreements.required_change: Project an exact trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fail closed.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis; 1/1 can appear as 100 percent thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive from canonical append-only shift history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying safe necessary upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is reason-only now, but because it is caller-supplied it would become self-reinforcing if connected directly to routing authority.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived from accepted evidence and tested against self-reinforcement.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only inside one aggregate invocation. Same evidence under new IDs and exact IDs across later calls/restart/rollback/poll can be re-credited; same-ID/different-binding is not durably detected.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience lacks mandatory exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt in the executable authority path.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable exact evidence identity plus trusted verifier acceptance receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: v2 can deny real Experience outside canonical C_VERIFIED while v2.1 independently recomputes positive verified_experience_delta from raw caller event_kind plus event_independently_verified.
disagreements.required_change: v2.1 must consume immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt or exact inherited eligibility and must not re-mint verified credit from raw caller fields.

disagreements.finding: Operational progress is granted from caller-supplied event_id/event_kind without durable artifact or defect acceptance proof.
disagreements.required_change: Require evidence-bound OperationalProgressAcceptanceReceipt plus lineage dedupe.

disagreements.finding: Weights 5/4/3 for verified classes and 1 for operational classes are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup. Commit count, wake count, heartbeat count, window age or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/randomized crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, canonical rework/rollback metric, and recovery_latency with frozen metric provenance and equal-or-better verification/risk quality.

statistical_risks: Metric-schema drift between rework_or_rollback_ratio and rework_ratio can change the numerator between baseline and candidate and create a false speedup.
Unbounded event batches can exhaust time/memory and bias cycle/recovery latency measurements even without duplicate-credit inflation.
Caller-declared secretary freshness and incomplete authority projection invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle, closure or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density can become self-reinforcing if fed back into routing authority.
Transient event identity, same-evidence/new-ID replay and raw-field credit paths can inflate longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
Caller-created operational events can inflate durable-progress numerator without proof of durable work.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics are numerator/denominator/exposure/order/coverage sensitive and require matched paired/crossover evaluation.
proposed_tests: GB21-SPEED-METRIC-MANIFEST-156: baseline and candidate must use the same immutable SpeedMetricManifest hash; changing rework-vs-rollback inclusion invalidates the paired comparison.

GB21-REWORK-ROLLBACK-DEFINITION-157: construct identical workloads with rework-only, rollback-only and mixed outcomes; verify the canonical metric produces the same interpretation in v2/v2.1 research and speed-audit consumers.
GB21-METRIC-EPOCH-158: changing metric definitions starts a new experiment epoch; old and new metric epochs cannot be pooled into one speedup estimate.
GB21-LEDGER-BATCH-LIMIT-153, GB21-LEDGER-NONTERMINATING-ITERABLE-154 and GB21-LEDGER-BUDGET-REPLAY-155 remain required.
Secretary freshness forge and exact AuthorityDecisionEnvelope projection tests remain required.
Shift-rate provenance, small-n, anti-thrash chatter/release and paired performance non-regression tests remain required.
Cross-run replay, rollback replay, same-evidence/new-ID lineage and same-ID/different-binding conflict tests remain required.
Verified evidence without exact trusted verifier/C receipt must yield zero authoritative verified credit.
Operational progress without durable artifact/defect receipt must yield zero authoritative operational credit.

Paired speed baseline must use durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency under sealed matched workloads and randomized/crossover order.

blocks: speedup claim until one versioned SpeedMetricManifest freezes rework/rollback semantics for both paired arms
claim that secretary freshness or fresh-authority precedence is executable from current caller booleans
claim that anti-thrash is calibrated or performance-safe from current caller-supplied shift ratio
authoritative verified Experience accounting from current raw-field paths
authoritative operational-progress/speed numerator accounting from raw caller event fields
speedup or capability claims from raw credit totals, commits, wakes, heartbeat count, window age or uptime

release_condition: Fresh exact-current v1+v2+v2.1 executable regression evidence exists on the same candidate bytes; historical results are not promoted as fresh PASS.

A versioned immutable SpeedMetricManifest defines durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with identical numerator/denominator/censoring semantics for baseline and candidate.
Experience ledger ingestion is bounded and resumable, with durable replay-resistant event/evidence-lineage accounting.

Every routing-relevant secretary-derived telemetry field is bound to source/freshness/scope/policy and exact fresh authority decisions are projected rather than represented only by authority_conflict booleans.
recent_shift_rate_ratio is derived from canonical shift history with precommitted minimum support/window/uncertainty and hysteretic release; paired tests show no cycle/closure/recovery regression.
verified_progress_density remains observational unless independently derived and proven non-self-reinforcing.
Verified Experience requires exact evidence identity plus trusted C/independent-verifier acceptance receipt; v2.1 cannot re-mint verified credit from raw event fields.
Operational progress requires durable artifact/defect acceptance receipt and lineage dedupe; caller event IDs alone cannot create speed numerator credit.
5/4/3/1 weights remain explicitly heuristic and are excluded from capability, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance and promotion truth claims.
Speedup is established only by sealed matched paired/randomized-crossover evidence using the frozen SpeedMetricManifest with equal-or-better verification quality and stable/lower rework-risk.
